entries: **Token estimates no longer undercount CJK text by a factor of four.** Six places in the waste diagnosis converted characters to tokens with `chars // 4`, which is the ASCII ratio. A CJK character is roughly one token, not a quarter of one, so every figure the diagnosis reported for a Chinese, Japanese or Korean file — wasted tokens and the cost derived from them — came out at a quarter of the truth. This project reads its own `i18n.json`, `CLAUDE.md` and `README.zh-TW.md` often enough to hit this on itself. The estimate now counts CJK codepoints as one token each and everything else at four characters per token. No tokenizer dependency was added: this is an offline tool, and pulling in a model-specific tokenizer to chase rounding-level accuracy is not a trade worth making.

**A corrupt disk cache is preserved instead of being deleted outright.** All three caches — Antigravity, Codex and history — dealt with an unreadable file by removing it and recomputing. That is the right recovery, but it also destroys the only evidence of what went wrong, so a later report of "my numbers look off" has nothing left to inspect. A damaged file is now moved to `~/.usage/quarantine/` first, named with a millisecond timestamp so a second failure cannot overwrite the first, capped at ten files and 5 MB each. A stale `schema_version` is *not* quarantined: that is an ordinary upgrade, and with 32 shards per cache one version bump would flush the whole budget and push the real evidence out. The quarantine helper swallows every error it can hit — it is a side service and must never take the caller down with it.

**`--doctor` no longer reports a missing file that the current mode does not use.** The report listed fourteen checks as one flat list, so `forwarder script: [missing]` read as a fault even when the installed mode never needs that script. It is now grouped into `[core]`, `[hook]` and `[optional]`, and the forwarder line says `[not needed in <state> mode]` when that is the case. None of the check logic changed.

**Two Windows tray tests wrote into the real `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`.** Both call `switch_panel()`, which persists through `_save_active_panel_id()`, and neither patched `prefs.PREFERENCES_FILE` — so running the suite silently changed the developer's own active panel.

**The documentation parity check covers Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.** `check_doc_parity.py` only compared English against Traditional Chinese, leaving the other three README translations unwatched; `CLAUDE.md` had to carry a note to sync them by hand. Each translation is now compared on its own and the failure message names the file that drifted. The comparison is still a count of `##` headings rather than their text — matching text would force translators to mirror English headings word for word, which is what makes translated docs read badly.

**`scripts/install_local.sh` replaces the hand-typed steps for installing a build locally.** Releasing does not touch `/Applications`: the tag drives CI, and the local copy keeps running whatever was already there. That last step lived only in a checklist, and the menu bar once ran a stale build for six versions before anyone noticed. The script checks the build exists, prints both versions, waits for the running app to exit, swaps it, and verifies the installed version matches.

title.zh-TW: 中文、日文、韓文的用量估算不再少算四倍
title.en: Usage estimates no longer count CJK text at one quarter of its size

body.zh-TW: 你拿中文、日文或韓文檔案檢查浪費的用量時，以前看到的數字其實少算了四倍。診斷工具把所有文字都當成四個字元才算一個 token（AI 處理文字量的單位），這套演算法適合 ASCII 文字，卻不適合 CJK 文字：一個中日韓字大約就是一個 token。現在它會把中日韓字逐一計算，其餘文字仍以四個字元估算，所以浪費的 token 與由此算出的費用不會再縮成四分之一。這像秤蔬菜時把每四顆番茄才當一顆，秤重結果當然偏低；秤法改正後，數字才接近實際重量。工具仍在離線運作，沒有為了追求細微的取整誤差加入特定模型的 tokenizer。
body.en: If you use Chinese, Japanese, or Korean files to diagnose waste, the old figures were four times too small. The diagnostic treated every four characters as one token (the unit an AI uses to measure text). That works for ASCII text, but a CJK character is roughly one token. It now counts each CJK codepoint as one token and keeps the four-characters-per-token estimate for everything else, so reported waste and the cost based on it no longer shrink to a quarter of their real estimate. It was like weighing tomatoes but recording only one for every four on the scale. The tool remains offline; it does not add a model-specific tokenizer just to chase tiny rounding differences.

title.zh-TW: 壞掉的快取先隔離，留下查問題的線索
title.en: A damaged cache is quarantined instead of erased

body.zh-TW: 某次用量數字看起來不對時，壞掉的快取（把查過結果暫存起來直接用的資料）現在不會立刻被刪光。Antigravity、Codex 與 history 三種快取遇到讀不懂的檔案，仍會重新計算以便繼續使用，但會先把原檔移到 `~/.usage/quarantine/`，讓你日後還能檢查出了什麼問題。每個檔名帶毫秒時間戳，第二次故障不會蓋掉第一次；隔離區最多留十個檔案，每個最多 5 MB。這像醫院把破損的檢體先放進證物袋，再重新採樣，而不是直接丟進垃圾桶。只有過期的 `schema_version` 不會被隔離，因為那是正常升級；每個快取有 32 個分片，一次升版若全送進隔離區，反而會擠掉真正的故障證據。

Antigravity, Codex, and history caches still recover by recomputing an unreadable file, but first move the original into `~/.usage/quarantine/` so there is something to inspect later. Names include a millisecond timestamp, so a second failure cannot replace the first; the folder holds at most ten files, up to 5 MB each. It is like bagging a damaged lab sample before taking a new one instead of throwing away the only clue. An old `schema_version` is excluded because it is a normal upgrade. With 32 shards per cache, quarantining an entire version bump would crowd out the evidence from a real failure.

A stale `schema_version` is *not* quarantined: that is an ordinary upgrade, and with 32 shards per cache one version bump would flush the whole budget and push the real evidence out. title.zh-TW: `--doctor` 會分清楚「缺檔」與「根本用不到」
title.en: `--doctor` separates a missing file from one you do not need

body.zh-TW: 跑 `--doctor` 檢查安裝狀態時，看到 `forwarder script: [missing]` 不必再先以為出錯。以前報告把十四項檢查攤成一張清單，即使你目前的模式根本不用 forwarder script（負責轉送資料的腳本），它也照樣標成 missing。現在結果分成 `[core]`、`[hook]` 與 `[optional]` 三組；不需要轉送腳本的模式會直接寫 `[not needed in <state> mode]`。這像健康檢查把必做檢驗、加選檢驗和不適用項目分欄，而不是把所有未做項目都標紅。檢查的判斷規則沒有改，改的是報告把情境講清楚的方式；真正缺少目前模式會用到的檔案，仍會顯示為問題。
body.en: When you run `--doctor` to check an installation, `forwarder script: [missing]` no longer automatically means trouble. The report used to flatten fourteen checks into one list, so it showed a missing forwarder script even in a mode that never uses one. A forwarder script is simply a script that passes data along. Results are now separated into `[core]`, `[hook]`, and `[optional]`; a mode that does not need the script says `[not needed in <state> mode]`. It is like a health report separating required tests, elective tests, and tests that do not apply instead of marking every absent test red. The checking logic itself did not change; a file required by the current mode is still reported as missing.

items.original: **`--doctor` no longer reports a missing file that the current mode does not use.** The report listed fourteen checks as one flat list, so `forwarder script: [missing]` read as a fault even when the installed mode never needs that script. It is now grouped into `[core]`, `[hook]` and `[optional]`, and the forwarder line says `[not needed in <state> mode]` when that is the case. None of the check logic changed.

title.zh-TW: Windows 的系統匣測試會寫入真實偏好設定
title.en: Windows tray tests write to your real preferences

body.zh-TW: Windows 開發者跑系統匣（Windows 工作列角落放背景程式圖示的區域）測試後，自己的面板偏好曾被悄悄改掉。兩個測試都會呼叫 `switch_panel()` 切換面板；這個動作接著透過 `_save_active_panel_id()` 寫入偏好檔，但測試沒有把 `prefs.PREFERENCES_FILE` 改指向暫存位置，於是實際碰到的是 `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`。換句話說，測試本來該在模型屋裡搬家具，卻走進你的家改了客廳。
body.en: After a Windows developer ran tray tests, their own panel preference changed in silence. The tray is the corner of the Windows taskbar where background-app icons live. Two tests call `switch_panel()`, which then writes preferences through `_save_active_panel_id()`. But the tests did not redirect `prefs.PREFERENCES_FILE` to a temporary location, so they wrote to the real `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`. The tests were meant to rearrange furniture in a model home, yet walked into your living room instead.

items.original: **Two Windows tray tests wrote into the real `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`.** Both call `switch_panel()`, which persists through `_save_active_panel_id()`, and neither patched `prefs.PREFERENCES_FILE` — so running the suite silently changed the developer's own active panel.

title.zh-TW: 四種 README 翻譯都有人守，不再只盯繁中
title.en: Documentation checks now watch all four README translations

body.zh-TW: 英文 README 多加一節時，簡體中文、日文和韓文版現在也會被檢查有沒有跟上。原本 `check_doc_parity.py` 只比對英文與繁中 README，其他三份翻譯沒有自動守門員，只能靠 `CLAUDE.md` 裡的手動提醒。現在每一種翻譯各自和英文比較，若落後，錯誤訊息會直接點出是哪個檔案。它比的是 `##` 標題的數量，不是標題文字本身：譯者仍可用自然的語言改寫標題，不必逐字照翻。這像展覽入口只數每個語言版有沒有同樣多扇展廳門，而不強迫門牌翻成同一串字；少了一扇門才提醒你回頭補。
body.en: When the English README gains a section, the Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean versions are now checked for keeping up too. `check_doc_parity.py` used to compare English only with Traditional Chinese, leaving the other three translations guarded only by a hand-written reminder in `CLAUDE.md`. Each translation is now compared with English on its own, and a failure names the file that drifted. The check counts `##` headings rather than matching their wording, so translators can still write natural headings instead of copying English word for word. It is like checking that every language edition of an exhibition has the same number of gallery doors, without forcing all the signs to use identical words.

items.original: **The documentation parity check covers Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.** `check_doc_parity.py` only compared English against Traditional Chinese, leaving the other three README translations unwatched; `CLAUDE.md` had to carry a note to sync them by hand. Each translation is now compared on its own and the failure message names the file that drifted. The comparison is still a count of `##` headings rather than their text — matching text would force translators to mirror English headings word for word, which is what makes translated docs read badly.

title.zh-TW: 本機安裝有了腳本，選單列不再默默跑舊版
title.en: A local-install script keeps the menu bar from quietly running an old build

body.zh-TW: 你剛做完本機 build（編譯完成、可執行的程式版本），標上 release tag 並不會自動換掉 `/Applications` 裡正在跑的 App。過去這一步只寫在檢查清單，曾讓選單列連續六個版本仍開著舊 build。現在要在本機安裝時，直接執行 `scripts/install_local.sh`：它先確認 build 存在，印出新舊兩個版本，等待正在執行的 App 結束，再替換檔案，最後核對已安裝版本是否相同。這像買了新燈泡卻只把盒子放在門口；打上標籤不等於已裝進燈座。腳本把拆舊燈、裝新燈和開燈確認串起來，讓本機副本跟著更新。
body.en: After you make a local build (a compiled, runnable version of the app), adding a release tag does not replace the copy already running from `/Applications`. That final step used to live only in a checklist, and the menu bar once kept running a build six versions old. For a local install, run `scripts/install_local.sh`. It confirms the build exists, prints both versions, waits for the running app to exit, swaps the files, and verifies that the installed version matches. Buying a new light bulb is not the same as putting it in the socket. The script links removing the old bulb, fitting the new one, and checking that the light turns on, so the local copy actually catches up.

items.original: **`scripts/install_local.sh` replaces the hand-typed steps for installing a build locally.** Releasing does not touch `/Applications`: the tag drives CI, and the local copy keeps running whatever was already there. That last step lived only in a checklist, and the menu bar once ran a stale build for six versions before anyone noticed. The script checks the build exists, prints both versions, waits for the running app to exit, swaps it, and verifies the installed version matches.

entries: **The panel no longer creeps downward every time you open and close it.** Dragging it into place used to hold for one cycle at most: each reopen landed it a little lower than the last. Two anchors disagreed. The saved position was the window's bottom-left corner, but `setContentSizeKeepingTopLeft_` — added in 0.29.9 precisely so the panel would not appear to jump while resizing — holds the *top* edge. To hold that edge it calls `setFrameOrigin_`, and macOS posts `NSWindowDidMoveNotification` for a programmatic move just as it does for a drag, so `windowDidMove_` recorded a resize as though the user had dragged the window. Every open re-measured the content height, the bottom-left corner dropped by the difference, and that drop was saved as the new position. The anchor is now the top edge on both sides, so resizing cannot change the stored value. Positions saved by earlier versions are read through a migration path and are not reset.

**Opening the panel no longer starts short and then stretches.** Two height systems were computing the same number and disagreeing: `popover_dimensions` estimates from a panel's base height by arithmetic (subtract a card when Claude or Codex is hidden, subtract a row when Codex has no data, add for a wrapped status line or an install button), while the script in `panels/dynamic_height.py` measures the rendered content and reports it back. The window opened at the estimate and jumped to the measurement. The gap was widest with cards hidden, where the most terms are subtracted. The measured height is now remembered per panel and used on open, leaving the estimate as a fallback for a panel that has never been measured. The arithmetic constants were deliberately left alone — tuning them is whack-a-mole, since every new UI element needs another adjustment. The panel still adjusts once when the content genuinely changes size.

**A state file corrupted into non-UTF-8 bytes no longer raises instead of degrading.** `_load_preferences`, `_load_ping_state` and `_load_last_ping` each catch `OSError` and `json.JSONDecodeError` around a `read_text(encoding="utf-8")` — but a file containing invalid UTF-8 raises `UnicodeDecodeError`, which is a sibling of `JSONDecodeError` under `ValueError`, not a subclass of it. All three are contracted to fall back quietly when their file is unusable, and a half-written or damaged file broke that contract by propagating the exception.

**The macOS notification bridge moved out of `menubar.py` into `menubar_notify.py`.** The six module-level functions that talk to `UNUserNotificationCenter` had no reason to live in a 2230-line file. They were not folded into `usage_notifications.py`, which stays free of PyObjC so its decision logic remains testable without the ObjC runtime — these functions call `objc.registerMetaDataForSelector`. The update-dismissal cooldown joined `update_gate.py`, where the other update-timing constants already were. `menubar.py` is down to 2139 lines and its ceiling followed.

**`jsonl_utils` and `time_utils` gained direct unit tests.** Both are shared by several loaders and had only incidental coverage through the modules above them. The JSONL reader's tolerance for blank lines, malformed rows and non-object values is now pinned, including the deliberate choice to raise on invalid UTF-8 when no `errors` argument is given — that decision belongs to the caller.

title.zh-TW: 面板記住位置與高度，開啟不再位移拉伸
title.en: Panels remember their position and height instead of shifting or stretching open

body.zh-TW: 每次打開又關閉面板後，若你已把它拖到順手位置，現在它不會一回比一回往下滑。之前它像掛歪的相框：儲存位置抓左下角，調整內容大小卻固定上緣；程式自己因高度改變移動視窗時，又誤當成你拖動，於是把偏移記下來。現在兩邊都認上緣，尺寸變動不會覆蓋你選的位置。舊版存下的位置也會經遷移（把舊資料換成新格式的轉換）讀取，不必重設。面板量過高度後，開啟不再先矮後拉長；尚未量過時仍以估算值作備援。內容真的變高或變矮時，仍會再調整一次。
body.en: After you drag a panel where you want it, opening and closing it will no longer make it creep lower each time. It was like a crooked picture frame: the saved position used its bottom-left corner, while resizing held its top edge; when the app moved the window for a height change, it mistook that move for your drag and saved the offset. Both sides now use the top edge, so resizing cannot overwrite your chosen spot. Older saved positions are migrated rather than reset. A measured panel no longer opens short and then stretches; an estimate remains the fallback before measurement. It still adjusts when content truly changes size.

title.zh-TW: 狀態檔讀到壞編碼，不再讓 usage 中斷
title.en: A damaged state file no longer stops usage cold

body.zh-TW: 某次電腦突然關機或檔案只寫到一半時，usage 的狀態檔（存偏好和上次連線資料的檔案）若混進不能用 UTF-8 的位元組，程式現在不會直接報錯中斷。它會把這份無法讀取的檔案當作暫時不可用，安靜改走備援處理。先前程式只攔住作業系統讀檔錯誤與 JSON 格式錯誤，卻漏了不合法 UTF-8 造成的解碼錯誤；三個載入偏好、連線狀態與上次連線時間的地方因此可能把錯誤一路丟出。這像讀到被水泡爛的便條：看不清就先放下，不讓整個工作台停擺。
body.en: If a computer shuts down suddenly or a file is written only halfway, a usage state file can contain bytes that are not valid UTF-8. That no longer throws an error and stops the app. The unreadable file is treated as temporarily unusable and the app falls back quietly. Previously it caught operating-system read errors and malformed JSON, but missed decoding errors from invalid UTF-8; three loaders for preferences, connection state, and last connection time could let that error escape. It is like finding a note soaked through with water: set it aside when you cannot read it, instead of shutting down the whole workbench.

title.zh-TW: 通知程式拆開、共用讀檔工具補上測試
title.en: Notification code is separated and shared file readers get direct tests

body.zh-TW: 你收到通知、或開發者修改共用讀檔工具時，這版沒有添畫面上的新按鈕，卻把容易藏錯的角落收好。macOS 的通知橋接程式（把 app 與系統通知中心接起來的程式碼）從龐大的選單列檔拆到獨立檔案；更新通知的冷卻時間也移到管理其他更新時機的地方。通知的判斷邏輯仍不依賴 macOS 專用元件，因此可在沒有 macOS 執行環境下測試。另一邊，讀 JSONL（每行一筆 JSON 資料的檔案格式）與時間的共用工具補上直接單元測試：空白行、壞行和不是物件的資料怎麼處理都被固定下來；未指定錯誤處理時，遇到壞 UTF-8 仍會報錯，決定權留給呼叫它的地方。像把工具櫃裡常用尺和螺絲起子逐件驗過，往後修其他東西時較不易誤踩壞掉的工具。
body.en: If you receive notifications or maintain shared file-reading code, this release adds no visible button but tidies places where bugs can hide. The decision logic still avoids macOS-only pieces, so it can be tested without that runtime. Meanwhile, the shared JSONL and time utilities get direct unit tests. Their behavior for blank lines, malformed rows, and non-object values is now pinned down; invalid UTF-8 still raises when the caller has not asked for error handling, leaving that choice to the caller. It is like checking each ruler and screwdriver in a tool cabinet before repairing something else.

**`jsonl_utils` and `time_utils` gained direct unit tests.** Both are shared by several loaders and had only incidental coverage through the modules above them. entries: **Removing the Codex status line no longer deletes one that `usage` never installed.** `_unsetup_codex()` only checked whether a `tui.status_line` existed at all, not whether it was ours. Anyone who had configured their own status line and then ran the removal lost it. Worse, a corrupt backup file made the restore path overwrite the config with an empty list and then delete the only backup, losing both at once. Removal now acts only when the status line matches `CODEX_STATUS_LINE` exactly, and an unreadable or wrong-typed backup leaves both the config and the backup untouched.

**A corrupt `~/.codex/hooks.json` is no longer treated as an empty one.** `_load_codex_hooks()` returned `{}` for "file missing" and "file exists but won't parse" alike; terse mode then rebuilt from that empty dict and wrote it back, permanently erasing every Codex hook the user had, with no backup and no message. Codex writing that file while `usage` reads it is enough to trigger this. The unreadable case now aborts before anything is copied or written, so a failed run can no longer leave a half-installed state either.

title.zh-TW: 移除 usage 不誤刪狀態列，讀壞掛鉤檔就停手
title.en: Removing usage preserves your status line, and unreadable hooks stop safely

body.zh-TW: 你曾把自己設定的終端機狀態列（終端機最底下顯示目前狀況的地方）留著，卻在移除 usage 加上的 Codex 狀態列時擔心它一起消失嗎？現在移除動作會逐字核對，只有完全等於 `CODEX_STATUS_LINE` 的那一列才會動；備份檔壞掉或內容型別不對時，設定和備份都原封不動。另一道保護留給掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）：`~/.codex/hooks.json` 不可讀時，usage 會中止，不再把它當空檔重寫，避免清掉你全部掛鉤，也不會留下半套安裝。像收走租來的衣架，先認準自己的標籤；看不清置物櫃裡的東西，就先不碰。
body.en: If you kept your own terminal status line, removing the Codex line added by usage used to risk taking yours with it. That protects every hook and avoids leaving a half-installed state. It is like collecting rented coat hangers only after checking their labels; if you cannot see inside a locker, you leave it alone.

entries: **The report and the terminal's session list now show what each conversation was about.** Claude Code names every conversation and writes that name into its transcript. `usage` had been parsing those names all along and carrying them into the report payload, where the renderer ignored them — the snapshot fixture still read `"Ignore in current renderer"`. The HTML report gained a "What you worked on" section under the contribution heatmap, and the TUI's recent-session table gained a column, so three rows from the same project are no longer indistinguishable. Titles carry `data-mask`, so the existing project-name masking covers them before a report is shared. Sessions without a title stay blank rather than falling back to the project name, which would read as a title that isn't one.

**A rate-limited Antigravity quota probe now waits as long as the server asked, instead of retrying every five minutes.** That probe is the only external API call in the project. It and the token refresh both folded `HTTPError` into the same `except` clause as connection failures, so a 429 reached the caller as a bare `None` — the status code and the `Retry-After` header were discarded together, and the next cache expiry sent another request at a server that had already said to wait. Each now catches `HTTPError` separately, reads `Retry-After` in either the seconds or the HTTP-date form, and holds off until it elapses. A missing or unparseable header falls back to sixty seconds, and the delay is capped at an hour so an oversized value cannot strand the card.

**The last minute before a quota resets no longer reads "0m".** Under sixty seconds the countdown's minute arithmetic rounds to zero, and the already-expired case printed the same string, so one line meant both "forty seconds left" and "the window has already turned". The card now reads "Reset imminent", in all five languages. The fix sits at the call site rather than in the shared duration formatter, which also renders the "will run out in" half of the burn warning — changing it there would have produced "will run out in reset imminent".

title.zh-TW: 報表與終端機看得出每段對話在忙什麼
title.en: Reports and terminal lists now reveal what each conversation was about

body.zh-TW: 同一個專案連開三段 Claude Code 對話，回頭看用量時，過去只能見到三列一模一樣的紀錄。現在 HTML 報表（網頁格式的報表）在貢獻熱圖下新增「你做了什麼」區塊，終端機的近期工作階段（session，一次開啟到結束的工作紀錄）清單也多了標題欄，能看出每段對話談過什麼。這些標題原本已由 Claude Code 寫進對話紀錄，usage 也讀到了，只有畫面沒顯示。分享報表前，標題會沿用既有的專案名稱遮罩；沒標題的工作階段維持空白，不會拿專案名冒充標題。像整理相簿時，原本三張都只寫「旅行」，現在終於有「登山」「吃飯」「回程」可辨。

Titles use the existing project-name masking before a report is shared. Untitled sessions remain blank instead of borrowing the project name and pretending it is a title. It is like sorting photos once labelled only "trip" and seeing "hike," "meal," and "ride home."

title.zh-TW: 額度檢查會照要求等待，重設前一分鐘不再寫 0m
title.en: Quota checks wait as requested, and the last minute no longer says 0m

body.zh-TW: Antigravity 的額度（可使用量上限）被伺服器要求晚點再查時，usage 現在會照指定時間等待。以前收到 429（請求太多）後，程式把狀態碼和 Retry-After（可再次嘗試前的等待時間）一起丟掉，快取（暫存查詢結果）一到期又每五分鐘重試。現在額度探測和 token（登入驗證用的令牌）更新都會另行處理 HTTPError（HTTP 回應錯誤），能讀秒數或 HTTP 日期格式的等待時間；缺值或無法解析時才等 60 秒，過大的值最多等一小時。倒數少於一分鐘不再寫「0m」，五種語言都改為「即將重設」，也不會污染「將在……耗盡」的另一種提示。像診所叫號，護士交代十分鐘後再來，就不會每五分鐘又跑去敲門；門快開時則會明講「快輪到了」。
body.en: When the server tells usage to check an Antigravity quota later, it now waits for the time requested. Previously, a 429 response meant both the status code and Retry-After header were discarded, so an expired cache triggered another attempt every five minutes. The quota probe and token refresh now handle HTTPError (an HTTP response error) separately and can read a wait time written in seconds or as an HTTP date; a missing or unparseable value falls back to 60 seconds, and an oversized value is capped at one hour. The final minute before reset no longer says "0m" in the same way as an already expired quota. All five languages now say "Reset imminent," and that wording stays out of the separate "will run out in" warning. It is like a clinic telling you to return in ten minutes instead of knocking again every five, then clearly saying your turn is next.

entries: **Nothing changes on screen in this release — it is housekeeping on the menu bar code.** `menubar.py` had reached 2485 lines, creeping past 2000 for the third time after being split apart twice. The icon and alert helpers moved into a new `menubar_chrome.py`, and the state constructors joined `menubar_state.py`, taking the file down to 2230. Only module-level functions moved: PyObjC binds `AppDelegate` methods by selector name, so relocating one would silently stop the matching control from working. `_popover_size` was split rather than moved, because it ends in `NSMakeSize` and `menubar_state.py` has to stay importable without the ObjC runtime for its projections to be unit-testable — the arithmetic moved as `popover_dimensions()` and a three-line shell stayed behind.

**The growth policy behind that cleanup is now enforced by CI rather than by discipline.** `scripts/check_file_size.py` fails the build when a guarded file passes its ceiling. The rule had been written in CLAUDE.md all along; nothing checked it, and the file grew back twice. Lower a ceiling when a cut lands, never raise it to go green.

**CLAUDE.md's module map lists only modules with a gotcha.** Half its rows restated what opening the file would tell you, and three separate rows repeated the same stdlib-only constraint. It went from 24 rows to 12.

title.zh-TW: 看不見的整理：選單列程式分家，尺寸規則自動把關
title.en: Invisible housekeeping: menu bar code gets divided up and size limits get enforced

body.zh-TW: 這版選單列畫面不變，整理藏在牆裡。`menubar.py` 已膨脹到 2,485 行，第三次超過 2,000 行。圖示與警示的輔助程式搬到 `menubar_chrome.py`，狀態建立程式移至 `menubar_state.py`，主檔降至 2,230 行。只移動檔案直屬函式。PyObjC（讓 Python 接上 macOS Objective-C 的橋樑）靠 `AppDelegate` 的方法名稱連接控制項，搬動它會令對應控制項失靈；`_popover_size` 則拆成計算函式，留三行外殼，讓無 ObjC 執行環境的單元測試仍能跑。接著，CI（自動檢查流程）開始替檔案尺寸守門，超限就讓建置失敗；切割檔案時降上限，別為通過檢查抬高它。CLAUDE.md 的模組地圖從 24 列縮到 12 列，只留會踩雷的說明。像整理屋內管線，表面不變，日後維修不必再越鑿越大。
body.en: Nothing new appears in the menu bar in this release; the work is behind the wall. `menubar.py` had grown to 2,485 lines and crossed 2,000 for the third time. CI, the automatic check run on changes, now fails a build when a guarded file exceeds its limit; after a cut, lower the limit rather than raising it to pass. CLAUDE.md's module map also shrank from 24 rows to 12, keeping only warnings that are not obvious from opening each module. It is like reorganizing plumbing: no new fixture appears, but later repairs need not keep breaking through a larger wall.

entries: **The panel can now be placed anywhere on screen**: it was an `NSPopover`, which AppKit anchors to the status item and dismisses the moment focus moves elsewhere, so where it sat was never yours to choose. It is now a borderless floating panel: drag it from any empty spot, and it reopens where you left it. It stays put when another app takes focus — a second click on the menu bar icon, or Escape, closes it. Rounded corners and the drop shadow came free with the popover and are now drawn by the window itself. Dragging travels over the existing JS bridge: an injected script reports a mousedown that landed outside any interactive or scrollable element, and the window hands the gesture to `performWindowDragWithEvent:` so the system drives it. Resizing pins the top-left corner, because a window's origin is its bottom-left and the panel would otherwise appear to jump every time its height tracked a fresh content measurement.

**The AI Talent Market panel no longer collapses into a squashed strip**: the panel intermittently opened at roughly the height of its own header, cutting off the team list. The dynamic content-height probe releases the layout's height constraints before measuring, and this panel builds its list as an absolutely positioned layer inside a `flex: 1` body — with the constraints released, that body collapsed to zero and the probe reported little more than the header, which the clamp then rounded up to the minimum panel height. Whether it happened came down to measurement timing, hence the intermittency. Panels now carry a switch for the probe, and this one — a fixed-height design that scrolls internally and never needed measuring — opts out.

**Dismissing the switch-panel menu no longer closes the panel**: opening "Switch Panel" and then clicking the panel itself, pressing Escape, or clicking away closed the whole panel. A transient popover was already gone by the time the menu took focus, so closing it was merely cleanup; the floating panel survives the menu, which turned the same cleanup into a mistouch that threw the panel away.

title.zh-TW: 面板能隨你擺放，切換視窗也不會消失
title.en: Put the panel where you want, and keep it there

body.zh-TW: 想把用量面板挪到螢幕邊角，現在直接拖曳空白處就行。它不再只能黏在選單列圖示旁、別的 app 取得焦點就收起，而是無邊框的浮動面板：放到哪裡，下次就從哪裡打開，圓角和陰影也照留著。檢查其他 app 時它仍待在原處；再按一次選單列圖示或按 Escape 才會關。拖曳不會搶走按鈕與捲動區的操作，內容高度變動時也固定左上角，因此不會像量尺從底端拉長般跳來跳去。
body.en: Want the usage panel in a screen corner? Drag any empty spot on it. It is no longer a popover stuck to the menu-bar icon that vanishes when another app gets focus; it is a borderless floating panel that reopens where you left it, with its rounded corners and shadow intact. It stays put while you check another app, and closes only when you click the menu-bar icon again or press Escape. Dragging leaves buttons and scrollable areas alone, while resizing holds the top-left corner still so the panel does not jump like a ruler stretching from its bottom edge.

title.zh-TW: AI 人才市集面板不再縮成一條
title.en: The AI Talent Market panel no longer squashes itself flat

body.en: The AI Talent Market panel sometimes opened as little more than its header, as if the team list had been folded into the bottom of a drawer. That list was not gone: while the app measured content height, it temporarily released layout constraints, and this fixed-height, internally scrolling list could collapse to zero. Timing made the failure intermittent. Panels can now opt out of that automatic measurement. AI Talent Market was always meant to keep a fixed height and scroll inside it, so it skips the measurement and opens with the full list visible.

title.zh-TW: 切換面板選單收起時，不再連面板一起關
title.en: Closing the Switch Panel menu no longer closes the panel too

body.zh-TW: 點開「切換面板」選單後，想回去看面板卻把整張面板關掉的烏龍沒了。以前選單打開時，原本的彈出式選單已經消失；清理它的動作卻誤把浮動面板當成也該收掉的東西。因此你按 Escape、點面板或點到別處，選單消失的同時面板也消失。現在清理只會關選單，浮動面板仍會安穩地繼續留在原處，像收起工具抽屜旁的小選單，桌上的工作紙不會一起被掃走。
body.en: The awkward moment when opening the “Switch Panel” menu made the whole panel disappear is gone. Previously, the temporary popover was already finished once the menu took focus, but its cleanup treated the floating panel as something to dismiss too. So pressing Escape, clicking the panel, or clicking elsewhere hid both the menu and the panel. Now cleanup closes only the menu. The floating panel stays, like folding away the little menu beside a tool drawer without sweeping the papers off your desk.

items.original: **Dismissing the switch-panel menu no longer closes the panel**: opening "Switch Panel" and then clicking the panel itself, pressing Escape, or clicking away closed the whole panel. A transient popover was already gone by the time the menu took focus, so closing it was merely cleanup; the floating panel survives the menu, which turned the same cleanup into a mistouch that threw the panel away.

entries: **The Windows panel no longer snaps back to the primary monitor on every panel switch**: dragging the popover onto a second display and then switching panel style (or theme) forced it right back onto the primary monitor. Windows' `SPI_GETWORKAREA` API only ever reports the *primary* monitor's work area, and the window was clamped against that single rectangle on every reposition regardless of which monitor it actually lived on — so a window dragged onto a secondary display got clamped straight back onto the primary one the next time the panel reloaded. Placement now looks up the work area of whichever monitor the window's current (or saved) position falls on via `MonitorFromPoint`/`GetMonitorInfoW`, so a window on a secondary display stays there across panel switches. A related issue on a single monitor is fixed alongside it: switching panels reset the remembered content height to `None`, so the window was briefly clamped against each panel's near-fullscreen placeholder height (`PANEL_HEIGHTS`) before its real height was measured, which could shove a dragged window toward the top of the screen; the previous panel's measured height is now kept as the transitional estimate instead.

title.zh-TW: 切換面板不再把視窗送回主螢幕
title.en: Panel switching keeps your window on its monitor

body.zh-TW: 你把 Usage 的面板（跳出的浮動小視窗）拖到第二台螢幕，換個面板樣式或主題後，它終於不會又跳回主螢幕。以前 Windows 只把主螢幕可用範圍交給程式，程式每次重新定位面板時便拿錯尺，硬把第二台螢幕上的視窗推回去；現在會依面板目前或記住的位置，找出它所在螢幕的可用範圍再定位，所以換樣式後仍留在原處。單螢幕也一併修好：面板切換時會暫留前一種樣式量到的高度，等真正高度測完，不再先用接近全螢幕的假高度把你拖好的位置往上擠。像搬家工人終於先看你住哪一棟，再把家具放回那一棟，而不是一律送回一樓。
body.en: After you drag Usage's panel (a small floating pop-up) to a second monitor, switching its style or theme will finally leave it there. Windows had only handed the app the primary display's usable area, so each reposition used the wrong ruler and shoved the panel back onto the primary monitor. It now identifies the usable area for the display containing the panel's current or remembered position. On a single monitor, it also retains the previous style's measured height while the new one is measured, instead of briefly using a near-fullscreen placeholder that pushes your window upward. Like movers checking which building you live in before returning furniture, rather than always dumping it in the lobby.

entries: **The panel no longer leaves an empty strip at the bottom**: panel height came from a fixed per-panel constant, so any layout that rendered shorter than the registered value left dead space below the footer. The common trigger is Codex reporting only a weekly window with no 5-hour data, which drops a quota row from the card. The panel now measures its own natural height after each refresh and the window resizes to match, clamped to the usable screen area; the registered constants stay as the pre-measurement default and as the fallback when a measurement is unusable. A panel that deliberately leaves room for a full-window backdrop — World Cup's pitch is the only one — marks that region so it keeps its designed height instead of collapsing while the measurement releases the layout's height constraints.

title.zh-TW: 額度面板會自己收好高度，不留底部空白
title.en: Quota panels now fit their content instead of leaving a blank strip

body.zh-TW: 你打開 Usage 面板（跳出來顯示額度的小視窗）查看 Codex 的每週額度時，底部不會再莫名多出一條空白帶。以前畫面高度照每張面板預設的固定值算；若 Codex 只回報每週時段、沒有 5 小時資料，額度卡少了一列，底下就留下死白。現在每次更新後，面板會量自己的實際高度，視窗隨著內容縮放，且不會超出可用螢幕範圍；量不出來時仍用原本數值當備援。這像量身裁衣：少一行內容就收短一點。只有 World Cup 的球場主題刻意預留滿版背景，會標記那塊空間，保留原本設計高度。
body.en: When you open the Usage panel to check Codex's weekly quota, an odd blank strip will no longer linger below it. The panel height used to come from a fixed preset. If Codex reported only a weekly window and no 5-hour data, the quota card lost one row but kept the extra height. Now, after each refresh, the panel measures its natural height and the window follows it without exceeding usable screen space; the old value remains a fallback if measuring fails. Think of a tailored hem: one less line of content, one less line of fabric. The World Cup pitch theme is the exception: it marks its intentional full-window backdrop so its designed height remains intact.

The common trigger is Codex reporting only a weekly window with no 5-hour data, which drops a quota row from the card. The panel now measures its own natural height after each refresh and the window resizes to match, clamped to the usable screen area; the registered constants stay as the pre-measurement default and as the fallback when a measurement is unusable. entries: **Claude Code panel no longer stays blank forever on Windows**: the installer picked whichever `python`/`py` `shutil.which()` found on `PATH` without checking it actually ran, so on any Windows machine without a real Python install, it silently wired the statusLine hook to Windows' non-functional "App Execution Alias" stub (the placeholder `python.exe`/`python3.exe` that Windows 10/11 ships by default to prompt a Microsoft Store install). The hook then failed silently on every refresh, `usage-status.json` was never written, and the Claude Code panel showed `--` permanently — not a first-run loading state. The installer now actually runs each candidate with `--version` before trusting it, and skips any that don't execute.

title.zh-TW: Windows 狀態列不再永遠空白
title.en: Windows status line no longer stays blank forever

body.zh-TW: Windows 電腦沒裝 Python 時，Claude Code 面板不會再永遠只顯示「--」。安裝程式原本只看 PATH（告訴電腦去哪找程式的搜尋名單）裡有沒有 `python` 或 `py`，卻沒確認它能不能跑；Windows 10、11 內建的 App Execution Alias 只是引你去 Microsoft Store 安裝的假 `python.exe`，也會被誤認。於是 statusLine hook（顯示在終端機最底下狀態列的掛鉤小程式）每次更新都靜悄悄失敗，`usage-status.json` 沒寫出來，面板便一直空白。現在安裝程式會先用 `--version` 實測候選程式，不能執行就跳過。像插座看似有孔、裡頭卻沒接電；現在會先試亮測電筆，才把線接上。
body.en: On a Windows PC without Python, the Claude Code panel will no longer show `--` forever. The installer used to trust any `python` or `py` found on PATH (the list of places Windows searches for programs) without checking whether it could run. Windows 10 and 11 ship an App Execution Alias: a placeholder `python.exe` that only sends you to Microsoft Store, yet it was mistaken for Python. The statusLine hook, a small program that updates the bottom status line, then failed silently on every refresh, so `usage-status.json` was never written. Now each candidate must pass `--version` first. It is like testing an outlet before plugging in the appliance.

The hook then failed silently on every refresh, `usage-status.json` was never written, and the Claude Code panel showed `--` permanently — not a first-run loading state. The installer now actually runs each candidate with `--version` before trusting it, and skips any that don't execute.
